title: Bihar Post-Matric Scholarship – BC / EBC
vacancyDetails: Post-matric scholarship application and status services for eligible BC and EBC students in Bihar.
qualification: BC / EBC students enrolled in eligible post-matric courses and meeting official scholarship conditions.
applicationFee: No fee unless specified by the official portal.
selectionProcess: Student registration -> Institute verification -> Department verification -> Scholarship processing
documentsRequired: Aadhaar, Bihar residence, caste certificate, income certificate, admission details, marksheet and bank account details.
howToApply: Visit the official BC-EBC PMS Bihar portal, register, complete the application and submit it through the institute verification process.
shortDescription: BC / EBC Bihar Post-Matric Scholarship portal for student application and status updates.
content:
Eligible BC and EBC students in Bihar can apply for post-matric scholarship through the official PMS Bihar portal.

Check the latest official notice for application dates, eligibility, document requirements and verification steps.
